_note: Default exports follow upstream's addSimpleComponentExport. A JavaScript component is the same isomorphic component a TS one is (unless it is a runes component without slots or events), so its instance has a real $on (no TS2722 on ref.$on) and its slots stay typed (let:untyped is any, not unknown). A legacy JS component's props and slots go through the __sveltets_2_partial fallback: an undefined-typed prop (export let x = undefined) accepts any value. The call signature takes Props & {$$events?, $$slots?}, or only the carriers when the component has no props, so Parameters<typeof C>[1] reports TS2322/TS2353 as upstream does. Verified against upstream svelte-check --tsgo with svelte 5.55.
